Agent Name: Fitness_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to execute the initial plan to use a mapping service (Google Maps API) to find gyms within 200 meters of Tompkins Square Park. Instead of resolving the missing API key or using an alternative method to verify the list, the agent manually selected three specific gyms (Blink Fitness, TMPL, East Side Athletic Club) without confirming they actually met the <200m distance constraint. This led to an incomplete search space, causing the team to miss the correct gyms (CrossFit East River and Avea Pilates) that do have early morning classes.
